findings.title: Phase 1 standard review: AC coverage, scope, spec fidelity all clean
findings.disposition_rationale: Diff is isolated to the new doctor stale-emit axis + its tests; all three ACs covered (1-2 by new tests, 3 by inherited gateway preamble behaviour); matches spec §3/§4 and the three ratified human-accept minors.

findings.action: Fixed — added a guard test asserting the real tsconfig resolves >=1 literal .ts/.js pair.
findings.title: glob/non-literal tsconfig include could make the axis a silent no-op on the real repo
findings.disposition_rationale: The real plugin/skills/faff/tsconfig.json uses literal .ts includes, so the axis fires here (glob->skip is the ratified minor-#1 behaviour, not a defect). The new guard test fails loudly if a future include switches to a glob and silently skips.

findings.action: Refuted — no change; ratified by-design behaviour.
findings.title: axis skips in a linked worktree with no installed toolchain
findings.disposition_rationale: This is the human-ratified decision stale-emit-check-fires-only-where-buildable and the spec's documented failure mode: a tree that cannot run npm run build gets no (unactionable) heads-up; FAFF-1171's CI gate is the backstop and the heads-up reappears once the toolchain is installed. Changing it would re-litigate a settled decision.

findings.action: Accepted risk — no change; out of scope per the ratified Chosen detection.
findings.title: buildable probe checks the compiler but not that a build script exists
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's ratified Chosen defines buildable as a resolvable typescript toolchain under node_modules specifically (§4), not script presence; this repo's package.json declares the build script, so the pathological typescript-without-build-script tree does not arise here.

findings.action: Refuted — no change; probe is correct on Windows.
findings.title: .bin/tsc probe is POSIX-shaped on Windows
findings.disposition_rationale: The extensionless tsc shim exists on Windows too, so the file-presence probe returns true correctly (toolchain present). No behavioural bug; reviewer rated it observation-grade.

findings.action: Refuted — no change; trusted repo-controlled input, no execution.
findings.title: tsconfig include entries are path.join'd without validating against escape
findings.disposition_rationale: tsconfig is repo-controlled, PR-reviewed, trusted input; the axis only stats mtimes and reports relative paths with no content read and no spawn, so an odd/absolute entry has nil impact.

findings.action: Accepted risk — no change; poll-style heads-up self-corrects.
findings.title: src-stat/emit-stat pair is not atomic (TOCTOU across a concurrent rebuild)
findings.disposition_rationale: Doctor is a poll-style heads-up that self-corrects on the next run; the spec explicitly accepts same-tick edit-and-rebuild as a tolerated best-effort miss (FAFF-1171 CI is the byte-exact authority).
